lines.en: I tap on Ami's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Hey, [amimaster]! I was just thinking about you.
: You're literally always thinking about me, though.
: I see no problem with this.
: Gonna invite me to my own house again?
: Yes. Would you like to come hang out at the place you are inside of right now?
: I was gonna go hang out with Maya, but I can stay here as long as you're coming home~
: In that case, I'll be there shortly.
: So, what did you want to do today?
How should I spend my time with Ami?
